data_versions.precis: RFC 8264 derived-property tables at Unicode 6.3.0 plus RFC 8265 UsernameCaseMapped; mapping, normalization, and bidi tables at Unicode 17.0.0

upgrade_rule: Changing Unicode, PRECIS, UTS #39, or UTS #46 data is a reviewed v1 artifact update. Existing canonical identifiers and signed bytes are never rewritten. UTS #39 upgrades rebuild authority-local derived collision indexes; newly assigned code points are rejected by receivers whose pinned profile does not yet recognize them.

profiles.name: arkret_human_identifier
profiles.canonical_equality: exact prepared Unicode code point sequence
profiles.authorization: may be uniquely indexed but is not a principal identifier
profiles.registration_collision: optional authority-local UTS #39 Highly Restrictive assessment and skeleton index; never canonical equality

profiles.name: arkret_external_string
profiles.canonical_equality: delegated to external standard, DID method, or provider profile
profiles.authorization: Arkret-wide NFKC or case folding is forbidden
